summary: Frontend UI verification for 3 bug fixes: (1) Callback row colors by scheduled_at proximity, (2) Smaller calendar appointment cards, (3) Area filter always visible across Week/Month/Year views. All 3 bugs confirmed fixed. Seeded 3 test callbacks (urgent <15min, soon <30min, later >30min) and 1 test appointment. Test 1 verified: red row #FEE2E2 + border #DC2626 + 'tra pochi minuti' text; orange row #FFEDD5 + border #F59E0B + 'tra meno di 30 min' text; yellow row #FEF9C3 + border #EAB308; borderWidth 1.5 on all; urgent row observed with opacity 0.72 (animated blink). Test 2 verified: card minHeight=44px, borderRadius=10px, apptTitle font-size 13px weight 700. Test 3 verified: [data-testid=cal-area-filters] visible in Settimana/Mese/Anno; all 4 chips (all/energy/network/birthday) reachable & clickable in every view. Minor cosmetic side effect: filter chip row appears vertically stretched (tall pills) in all views because the horizontal ScrollView lacks a fixed height and children have flexShrink:0.

issues: Area-filter horizontal ScrollView (testID cal-area-filters) renders as very tall pills (chips stretch vertically) — likely missing an explicit height/maxHeight on the ScrollView or an alignItems:'center' on contentContainerStyle. Visible in all 3 views (Settimana/Mese/Anno). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/calendario.tsx:143 (styles.filtersRow at line 291).

react_native_issues.issue: Multiple 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' warnings in the console after login. Likely a whitespace text node in some (tabs) screen JSX. Reference: repeatedly logged during Home render.

'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow' — appears at app start (react-native-web). Multiple files use shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset (e.g., home.tsx:469 styles.statCard).

action_items: OPTIONAL: constrain the cal-area-filters horizontal ScrollView height (e.g., style={{maxHeight: 44}} or wrap in a View with fixed height) so filter chips don't stretch vertically in the Year/Month views.
OPTIONAL: migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow to remove deprecation warnings.
OPTIONAL: track down and remove the stray whitespace text nodes that trigger 'Unexpected text node' warnings on the Home screen.
critical_code_review_comments: home.tsx CallbackRow: setInterval fires every 20s but the animated blink loop restarts only when urgent/soon flags change — acceptable but means a callback crossing the 15/30 min threshold may take up to 20s to re-render the color, which is fine.
calendario.tsx: styles.card now has minHeight:44 which meets the 44px touch-target guideline for the Pressable — good.
